description: Align bot creation API with Clawd scheduler Redis protocol - implement VM selection, per-VM queues, bot lifecycle management

userStories.title: Add nanoid dependency
userStories.description: As a developer, I need nanoid installed to generate unique bot IDs in format bot_{nanoid(10)}.
acceptanceCriteria: Install nanoid package: npm install nanoid
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create scheduler service module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a scheduler service to query VMs from Redis and select the best one based on available RAM.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/server/scheduler.ts
Export getHealthyVms() that queries vm:* keys and filters by status === 'healthy' and heartbeat < 2 min
Export selectBestVm(vms) that returns VM with most ram_available (min 1GB free)
Reuse TLS connection logic from src/lib/server/redis.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Existing code to reuse: src/lib/server/redis.ts for connection with TLS

userStories.title: Create bot service module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a bot service to handle all Redis operations for bot lifecycle management.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/server/bot-service.ts
Export registerBot(botId, vmId, teamId, profiles, config) using HSET bot:{bot_id} and SADD team:{team_id}:bots
Export getBot(botId) using HGETALL bot:{bot_id}
Export getTeamBots(teamId) using SMEMBERS + pipelined HGETALL
Export updateBotStatus(botId, status) using HSET
Export deleteBot(botId) using SREM + DEL
Export sendCommand(vmId, command) using LPUSH vm:{vm_id}:queue
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 (nanoid). Core module used by all API endpoints.

userStories.title: Rename and refactor create bot endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the bot creation endpoint to use per-VM queues instead of pub/sub and follow the Redis Protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename src/routes/api/vms/+server.ts to src/routes/api/bots/+server.ts
Update POST handler to use getHealthyVms() + selectBestVm() from scheduler
Return 503 if no VMs available
Generate bot ID: bot_${nanoid(10)}
Build CREATE command payload per Redis Protocol (type, bot_id, team_id, profiles, config)
Call registerBot() from bot-service to store in Redis
Call sendCommand() from bot-service to queue on VM
Keep existing channel validation schemas (Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002, US-003. Existing code to keep: channel validation schemas from old api/vms.

userStories.title: Add GET /api/bots endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to list all bots for my team.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET handler to src/routes/api/bots/+server.ts
Parse team_id query parameter
Use getTeamBots(teamId) from bot-service
Return array of bot objects with all Redis fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-003. Replaces placeholder GET in old api/vms.

userStories.title: Add GET /api/bots/[id] endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to get details for a specific bot.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/api/bots/[id]/+server.ts
Add GET handler that extracts id from params
Use getBot(botId) from bot-service
Return 404 if bot not found in Redis
Return bot object with all fields
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add POST /api/bots/[id]/stop endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to stop a running bot.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/api/bots/[id]/stop/+server.ts
Add POST handler that extracts id from params
Get bot from Redis using getBot(), return 404 if not found
Send STOP command to VM queue using sendCommand()
Update bot status to 'stopped' using updateBotStatus()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add POST /api/bots/[id]/start endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to start a stopped bot.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/api/bots/[id]/start/+server.ts
Add POST handler that extracts id from params
Get bot from Redis using getBot(), return 404 if not found
Send START command to VM queue using sendCommand()
Update bot status to 'running' using updateBotStatus()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add POST /api/bots/[id]/delete endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to delete a bot permanently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/api/bots/[id]/delete/+server.ts
Add POST handler that extracts id from params
Get bot from Redis using getBot(), return 404 if not found
Send DELETE command to VM queue using sendCommand()
Call deleteBot() from bot-service to remove from Redis
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add POST /api/bots/[id]/credits endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to add credits to my bot for billing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/api/bots/[id]/credits/+server.ts
Add POST handler that extracts id from params
Validate request body: { amount: number }, amount must be positive integer
Get bot from Redis using getBot(), return 404 if not found
Send CREDIT_ADD command to VM queue using sendCommand() with amount
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update GET /api/vms endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see VM capacity and health status.
acceptanceCriteria: Update GET handler in src/routes/api/vms/+server.ts
Use getHealthyVms() from scheduler service
Return all VMs with parsed metrics (vm_id, status, ram_total, ram_available, ram_used, cpus, bot_count, last_heartbeat)
Include is_healthy flag based on heartbeat < 2 min
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002. Replaces placeholder GET in api/vms.

userStories.title: Deprecate old VM creation endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to keep backward compatibility while migrating to the new API.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep POST handler in src/routes/api/vms/+server.ts for backward compatibility
Add deprecation warning log: console.warn('[DEPRECATED] POST /api/vms is deprecated, use POST /api/bots')
Add deprecation header in response: X-Deprecated: true
Forward request to new bot creation logic
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-004. For backward compatibility during transition.
